summary: Form 6-K filed by AXIA Energia S.A. (formerly Eletrobras) on June 2, 2026, reporting an S&P Global Ratings update. S&P affirmed its 'BB' issuer credit rating, revised the management/governance score to neutral from moderately negative, and maintained a stable outlook. The rating action cites improved governance framework after a Supreme Court-approved agreement with the federal government, which caps government voting power at 10% and limits interference. The filing also notes AXIA's planned R$13-14B capex in 2026, expected leverage reduction, and the pending sale of its Eletronuclear stake to Ambar Energia. This is a routine credit rating update, not a special-situation transaction.
